title: Redemption Rate Card — Visit Spacing, Network and Void Window, KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
Visits under KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans are spaced by a minimum distance and a minimum number of days, limited per rolling 12 months, and redeemed directly by the Kestrel service network. The rate card gives those figures for every plan level.

## Spacing and frequency

| Plan level | Minimum miles between two redeemed visits | Minimum calendar days between two redeemed visits | Maximum visits redeemed in any rolling 12 months | Two visits on the same day |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| KestrelCare Maintenance Starter | 3000 | 60 | 2 | Not allowed |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Basic | 3000 | 60 | 3 | Not allowed |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Standard | 3000 | 60 | 4 | Not allowed |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Plus | 3000 | 60 | 4 | Not allowed |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier | 3000 | 60 | 4 | Not allowed |
| KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max | 3000 | 60 | 4 | Not allowed |

## Network, VIN and void window

| Term | Every plan level |
|---|---|
| Facilities that redeem visits directly | Kestrel service centers; Kestrel partner quick-lube network |
| Facility must match the plan VIN on the vehicle before redeeming | Yes |
| Calendar days after a redemption within which a redemption recorded in error is voided | 14 |

## Notes

- The spacing figures are the same at every level; only the rolling 12-month maximum differs, rising from 2 visits on a KestrelCare Maintenance Starter plan to 4 visits on Standard and every level above it.
- The 14-day figure is counted in calendar days after the redemption.
- Hypothetical comparison: a holder of a KestrelCare Maintenance Basic plan (an example only) may have up to 3 visits redeemed in any rolling 12 months, each at least 3000 miles and at least 60 calendar days after the previous one, with no two on the same day.
